routes.name: Avocado Super Smoothie
routes.desc: Starts just to the left of Waltz, on the left side of the banyan tree. Originally envisaged as an abseil escape from pitch three of Waltz but became it's own route. 1. 28m (6a+) 8 bolts 2. 21m (6a) 8 bolts. Be careful to head up the correct route here as it shares an anchor with P2 of Waltz for a Lovely Wife. Avocado is the left route with the newer bolts. 3. 30m (6a) 7 bolts & 1 piton DESCENT NOTES: Generally straight down with some sharp rock. P3: if abseiling directly from the ring a 60m rope will be a bit short; it will be about 32m. P1: there is a second anchor just below the main obvious one. Use this for less rope rub and an easier pull. FA: Yew, Yew Liang & QX

routes.name: Waltz for a Lovely Wife
routes.desc: Start just to the L of Last Day. 1. 30m (5+) 13 Quickdraws 2. 25m (5) 8 Quickdraws. Be careful to head up the correct route here as it shares an anchor with P2 of Avocado Super Smoothie. Waltz is the right route with the older bolts. 3. 35m (5) 9 Quickdraws 4. 30m (5) 8 Quickdraws 5. 33m (5) 8 Quickdraws 6. 33m (5+) 6 Quickdraws 7. 20m (3-4) No bolts. Abseil descent using Corcovado, or abseil the top 3 pitches of Waltz and then continue abseiling down Avocado Super Smoothie. Set: Jean-Jacques Braun & Ben Grasser

routes.name: Corcovado
routes.desc: 1. 18m Three Dwarves and a Nut. 6 Quickdraws 2. 22m (6a) 6 Quickdraws (Pitch 1 and 2 can be linked into one 40m pitch but you NEED to extend the draws at the start + going over the lip) 1. 30m (6a) 9 Quickdraws 2. 26m (6a) 9 Quickdraws 3. 36m (6b) 11 Quickdraws 4. 17m (5+) 5 Quickdraws 5. 20m (2+) No Bolts. An uncut 70m rope JUST makes the pitch 5 rappel. Please tie a knot at the end of your rope. Set: Ben Grasser, Worapot Klapsawat (Tao) & Sirilak Amprueang (Joy)

routes.name: Leverage - งัดถั่งงัด งัดถั่งงัด (Ngat tha Ngat tha Ngat)
routes.desc: To the left of Nok Khao. Climb into the cave as climbing Pratimakam and punch out to the left to the base of the long stalactite system on the steep overhanging wall. You can choose to belay here for less drag. Otherwise fire up the never ending stalactite and bear hug your way up some cool climbing. Wall gets steeper towards the chains and require lot of endurance and funky foot work. Lower back to the ground with a single 70m rope Name inspired by the local song everyone was plagued by while bolting the route! Thanks to Verticale (Malaysia for the Singing Rock hangers) and Kang Hao for flying out here to put up this route and generous donation Credit. TaoSpeedWagon Duplicate info from MountainProject.com FA: QX, 14 Feb 2020

routes.name: Leverage Leverage Leverage!!
routes.desc: Extension of 'Leverage' Some features here are really fragile so be careful. Followed by firing up the what feels like 60degree overhanging hand cracks to a thank god jug. Traverse out on the thin rail on a no feet traverse and hit a series of pockets and jugs. A interesting sequence before ending on the huge jug system on top. Good job, your forearms are done for the day. If you are belaying from the base of the stalactite, a 70m should get you back into the cave. FA: Kang, 11 Jan 2024
